name: Volcanic ash and black-sand surface family

variants.note: Broad powder drifts on inland basalt.
Dense wet beach body with a darker swash margin.
Small separated fireweed clumps in cooled ground; never on active lava.

approval.note: W0 design proposal for Claude review; no art, material ID, painter or live placement approval.

story.lore: Reuse the volcano’s fallout across Cinder Rise, dead forest and the black-sand cove.
